logical_floor.meaning: One walkable logical floor section and one actor/object anchor.

rectangular_bands.meaning: A straight rectangular passage with independently measured length, doorway thickness, and margins within the adjoining room walls.

vertical.room_shift_x: top_left_margin - bottom_left_margin; positive values mean the lower room begins farther east

rectangular_bands.centering: A passage is centered only when opposing margins match at both ends; unequal margins are valid offset openings.
rectangular_bands.room_alignment: The margin pairs at the two ends may differ while the corridor remains straight. Different pairs describe shifted adjoining room shells, not a corridor bend.

staggered_paths.meaning: A one-section-thick orthogonal corridor whose upper and lower openings occupy different wall positions.
staggered_paths.direction: Derived from the sign of bottom_x - top_x.
staggered_paths.path: Upper vertical stem, one horizontal bend row, and lower vertical stem.
staggered_paths.status: approved for the eastward dogleg fixture

elevation.meaning: A non-negative height stored separately for each occupied floor section.
elevation.connectivity: Cardinally connected sections at equal positive height form one platform.
elevation.actor_anchor: Logical actor anchors remain unchanged by elevation.

projection.visual_model: nested Grammar v2 shell shifted to the platform logical origin
projection.face_clearing: North underside and south hanging-face rows clear buried lower-floor lattice before platform glyphs compose.
projection.top_lattice: The platform top retains lattice points derived from its own occupied footprint.
projection.next_after_corridors: Resume platform visual approval after wide vertical and combined wide-offset corridor cases are resolved.

lattice.meaning: A shared interior intersection surrounded by four occupied floor sections.

east_cap.rule: An underside terminating into an east-wall face reserves one recessed blank column before the face slash.

open_work: Approve or revise the two-section-wide vertical corridor doorway and shaft transitions.
Add a corridor that is both wide and offset within its adjoining room walls.
Add mirrored shifted-room and westward dogleg regressions.
Integrate approved Grammar v2 structures into the full scene renderer.
